resolved_findings.verification: All eight `one` arms now interpolate `{count}`; a scan of every `one` arm in the namespace finds no literal digit 1 outside the three intentional `=1` arms. Formatting under ru (where `one` also selects 21, 31, 101) now reports the real number, e.g. «Запуск конфигурации завершён: 21 определение изменено.», «…101 определение изменено.», «21 чат отмечен как прочитанный.», «21 отметка остаётся на других устройствах и снимется, когда они обновятся.», «21 отметка получила более новые результаты и остаётся непрочитанной.», «21 отметка не снята и остаётся непрочитанной.», «Не удалось сохранить 21 запись учётных данных …», «Не удалось подтвердить сохранение 21 записи учётных данных …».

The `few` arm is now accusative «{count} записи» (was genitive plural «записей»). Rendered at the counts that select it: count=2 → «Не удалось сохранить 2 записи учётных данных (API_KEY); агенту сообщено об этом. …», count=3 and 22 identical in shape, count=5 (many) → «5 записей …» and count=1 → «1 запись …», both already correct and unchanged.

The plural predicate «Сохранены {keys}» is now the count-neutral «Сохранено: {keys}.». Rendered for the common single-key path: «Сохранено: API_KEY. Каждый подставляется в каждую команду bash как переменная окружения; агент не может прочитать значение.» and for a list: «Сохранено: API_KEY, DB_URL, TOKEN. …». The second sentence is unchanged and still reads for one key.

Now «Запросов на одобрение сайтов: {count, number}. Одобрите или отклоните их во вкладке браузера.» — the round-1 proposal verbatim. Rendered at 5 → «Запросов на одобрение сайтов: 5. …»; at 1234 the `{count, number}` argument groups with an NBSP → «1 234». 93 characters against the sidecar's ~170-character OS-banner budget.

The English curly quotes were removed from code and the quoting moved into the catalogue: ru supplies «{title}» and archiveOfferedName() now calls t() for it. Composed as the toast joins the truncating head to the shrink-0 tail: «Отчёт за квартал» — в архиве. No English curly quotes remain in any of the 94 ru values; the guillemet pair is the one the rest of the namespace uses (archive_failed, unarchive_failed).

verification.typography: All 94 ru values: guillemets « » in prose and no “ ”/straight quotes anywhere; every em dash spaced on both sides; no space before : ; ! ?; no double, leading or trailing whitespace; no NBSP or bidi controls in the source; no exclamation marks. The new value carries no space inside its guillemets, matching the ru house style (fr's narrow-space pair is fr's own).
verification.register: No ты/тебя/твой form anywhere in the namespace (word-boundary scan); the changed values keep the impersonal вы-register (Одобрите или отклоните; Вставьте значение ещё раз) and sentence case.
verification.widths: Changed strings against EN source length: consent_body_many 93/84, credentials.stored 122/108, credentials.unconfirmed 331/215, credentials.unstored 282/171, archive_offered_title 9/9 (ICU syntax included in the plural figures). No changed string is materially longer than its EN source; the only rendered-budget surface is the OS banner (consent_body_many, ~170 budget). The archive head is the truncating half and the verb tail is unchanged at 11 characters.

observations: OBS-01: the `other` (fraction) arms keep plural predicates («1,5 отметки остаются …»). Every call site passes an integer — mark-all-read counts come from store counts, credentials from the captured key list length, config runs from a definition count — so `other` is unreachable in practice. Unchanged from round 1 and not a defect.

OBS-02: mark_all_read_unknown's `one` arm uses a different construction from its `=1`/few/many arms («не снята и остаётся» versus «не удалось снять — она/они остаются»). Both are grammatical and count-correct, and the implementer's wording differs from the round-1 proposal while addressing the same defect (no singular pronoun asserting one mark at 21). No action.

OBS-03: mark_all_read_superseded's `one` arm puts a plural object after the distributive singular subject («21 отметка получила более новые результаты»). That is idiomatic Russian for a numeral subject and matches the English plural 'have newer results'; no action.

OBS-04: the plural messages interpolate `{count}` as a plain argument, not `{count, number}`, so a four-digit count renders ungrouped («1234»). That mirrors the English source's own pattern, is unchanged by this delta, and only main.consent_body_many uses `{count, number}` (which groups with an NBSP).

OBS-05: no rendered frame was captured for this delta; it is a source-and-formatter audit, so no clipping claim is made at a specific window width. The archival tail remains a shrink-0 flex item and the new head stays the truncating half.

summary.note: All three round-1 majors are resolved with the required shape, and the minor and nit are resolved too; the remaining 83 unchanged values re-check clean. 94 keys read, 11 changed values reviewed, 0 findings of any severity.

verdict.reason: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor, 0 nit. Every `one` arm in the eight RU-NOT-01 keys prints {count} (verified at 21 and 101, where ru's `one` selects); the three non-count-neutral messages carry exactly one `=1` arm; credentials.unstored's `few` arm is accusative «записи»; credentials.stored is count-neutral; the consent banner calque is gone; the archive quotes are the locale's own. Placeholder integrity, plural categories, register and typography hold across the namespace.
